program_solutions:
(rule!
 ;; Loose solid shapes get filed into hollow rectangular frames. Each
 ;; shape (top-left order) takes the frame it fits tightest — rotated
 ;; 90 degrees if only that fits — preferring less leftover interior,
 ;; then the topmost/leftmost frame; each frame holds one shape,
 ;; centered. Output: the frames with their contents, nothing else.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (obj< a b)
       (if (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
           (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))
           (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))))
     (define (object-grid obj)
       (paint-cells (empty-grid (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj) 0)
                    (normalize-cells (obj-cells obj))
                    (obj-color obj)))
     (define (stamp out sub tr tc)  ;; nonzero cells only, clipped
       (foldl (lambda (cell acc)
                (let ((r (+ tr (first cell))) (c (+ tc (second cell))))
                  (if (and (not (= (third cell) 0))
                           (in-bounds? r c (rows acc) (cols acc)))
                      (set-cell acc r c (third cell))
                      acc)))
              out (grid-cells sub)))
     (define (rect-frame? obj)
       (and (>= (obj-h obj) 3) (>= (obj-w obj) 3)
            (= (obj-size obj)
               (- (* 2 (+ (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj))) 4))
            (all? (lambda (c) (and (= (at g (obj-r1 obj) c)
                                      (obj-color obj))
                                   (= (at g (obj-r2 obj) c)
                                      (obj-color obj))))
                  (range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1)))
            (all? (lambda (r) (and (= (at g r (obj-c1 obj))
                                      (obj-color obj))
                                   (= (at g r (obj-c2 obj))
                                      (obj-color obj))))
                  (range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1)))))
     (define (fit-of entry og)
       ;; (leftover frame-r1 frame-c1 idx frame oriented-shape) or #f
       (let* ((frame (second entry))
              (ih (- (obj-h frame) 2))
              (iw (- (obj-w frame) 2))
              (rot (rotate-cw og))
              (fit (cond ((and (<= (rows og) ih) (<= (cols og) iw)) og)
                         ((and (<= (rows rot) ih) (<= (cols rot) iw))
                          rot)
                         (else #f))))
         (and fit
              (list (- (* ih iw) (* (rows fit) (cols fit)))
                    (obj-r1 frame) (obj-c1 frame)
                    (first entry) frame fit))))
     (define all-objs (objects g 0))
     (define frames (sort (filter rect-frame? all-objs) obj<))
     (define indexed (enumerate-list frames))
     (define solids
       (sort (filter (lambda (o) (not (rect-frame? o))) all-objs) obj<))
     (define (best-fit og used)  ;; tightest, then topmost/leftmost
       (let ((cands (filter (lambda (x) x)
                            (map (lambda (e)
                                   (and (not (member (first e) used))
                                        (fit-of e og)))
                                 indexed))))
         (and (not (empty? cands))
              (first (sort cands
                           (lambda (a b)
                             (cond ((not (= (first a) (first b)))
                                    (< (first a) (first b)))
                                   ((not (= (second a) (second b)))
                                    (< (second a) (second b)))
                                   (else (< (third a) (third b))))))))))
     (let assign ((remaining solids) (used (list))
                  (out (for/fold ((o (empty-grid h w 0)))
                                 ((f (in-list frames)))
                         (paint-cells o (obj-cells f) (obj-color f)))))
       (if (empty? remaining)
           out
           (let ((hit (best-fit (object-grid (first remaining)) used)))
             (if hit
                 (let* ((frame (fifth hit))
                        (sub (sixth hit))
                        (tr (+ (obj-r1 frame) 1
                               (quotient (- (- (obj-h frame) 2)
                                            (rows sub))
                                         2)))
                        (tc (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1
                               (quotient (- (- (obj-w frame) 2)
                                            (cols sub))
                                         2))))
                   (assign (rest remaining) (cons (fourth hit) used)
                           (stamp out sub tr tc)))
                 (assign (rest remaining) used out))))))))
